correctness.rationale: Exact domain: nine-subsets of Z/56 with all 36 distinct-index pair sums distinct. Ascending-prefix search from zero generates every anchored valid subset once and prunes only a repeated pair sum or unavailable larger elements. The standalone Python checker visits 3455863 nodes and returns exactly 216 valid anchored subsets; it independently produces 1344 distinct affine images of the explicit witness and checks that the 216 anchored images equal the enumeration. Incidence double counting yields exactly 1344 valid full subsets, so the one orbit is exhaustive. An independent C++ search independently gives anchored count 216 and orbit count 1. The known minimality of modulus 56 is attributed to the 2004 source, not newly proved.

One-orbit rigidity and exact 1344/216 counts resolve this design-equivalence question completely, beyond known optimal modulus 56 and individual witnesses. The 2026 composite-DNA checksum scheme motivates the precise object and equivalence; the result is intentionally finite and does not claim a broader channel optimum.
